$comment: MCP server presets (E50.12, #982), reviewed like code. A preset only fills the Add dialog: the server is still tested before anything is kept, every tool starts off, and the administrator's host lists still apply (a preset on a blocked host is not offered). Never a secret, never a tool mode. Each address was checked against the vendor's own documentation on the date in `verified`; re-check it when you change an entry. apps/api/test/mcp-presets.spec.ts checks every entry's shape.

presets.name: GitHub
presets.notes: GitHub's remote MCP server. Sign in with a personal access token of yours (sent as a bearer token). Its OAuth sign-in needs an app registered for this console.

presets.name: Sentry
presets.notes: Sentry's hosted MCP server. You sign in at Sentry's own page.

presets.name: Cloudflare documentation
presets.notes: Searches Cloudflare's public documentation. Its documentation names no sign-in; the test when you add it says if one is needed.
